definition: ACBD6 refers to acyl-CoA-binding domain-containing protein 6 and its encoding gene, in which bi-allelic loss-of-function mutations are causative of neurodevelopmental disorder with progressive movement abnormalities (OMIM #620785), characterized clinically by developmental delay accompanied by a wide spectrum of hypo- and hyperkinetic movement abnormalities, including chorea.

source.title: Update on Genetic Chorea
source.quote: Recently, a bi-allelic loss-of-function mutation in the ACBD6 gene was found in cases with developmental delay and a broad spectrum of both hypo- and hyperkinetic movement
